explication: OpenTelemetry Rust is a multi-crate observability implementation: applications instrument code through shared APIs, SDKs collect and process logs, metrics, and traces, and exporters deliver telemetry to backends or stdout. The API also provides context, baggage, and propagation; logging appenders bridge existing logging frameworks. The README documents the major exporter and signal capabilities, but most implementation files were not sampled, so edges between internal stages are limited to relationships it explicitly describes.
